mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically from -16.3% to -12.0% over four weeks, indicating a consistent recovery trend independent of external shocks. This trend will persist over the next four weeks, driving RETAIL_REC further positive.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 4.3 percentage points over t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean of the last 28 days, or reverses by more than 2 percentage points in any single week.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has risen from 1.3% to 4.7% over four weeks, signaling increased essential-trip confidence. This behavioral shift reduces risk aversion and spills over into discretionary retail visits, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds 3.0% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM at +4.7% in t-0w, highest in snapshot
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 2.0% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to baseline within 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has stabilized around -50% over three weeks but improved 5.1 points to -45.6% in t-0w. This signals resumption of commuting infrastructure use. Sustained TRANSIT recovery over the next two weeks will drive workplace attendance and associated retail footfall.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by more than 3 percentage points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 5.1 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT does not improve further in the next week, or WORKPLACES remains below -10% while RETAIL_REC declines.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has declined from 7.9% to 5.7% over four weeks, indicating reduced lockdown-driven home confinement. This deconfinement trend, if sustained, will release pent-up retail demand over the next four weeks, raising RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 6.5% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined 2.2 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rebounds above 7.0% in any week over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not improve relative to the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility remains severely depressed at -27.7%, indicating outdoor recreation is still constrained. If PARKS remains below -20% over the next two weeks, consumers will substitute into indoor retail venues, raising RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -20% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at -27.7% in t-0w, consistently depressed
failure_condition: PARKS improves above -15% within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has deteriorated from -14.6% to -13.7% (slight improvement) but remains severely suppressed. Coupled with TRANSIT stagnation at -45.6%, this signals weak commuting recovery. Retail will remain depressed as discretionary spending follows workplace attendance patterns.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES remains below -10% AND TRANSIT remains below -40%
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES at -13.7%, TRANSIT at -45.6% in t-0w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES improves above -5% or TRANSIT improves above -35% within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC exceeds the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-July in Melbourne marks the onset of winter school holidays. PARKS suppression at -27.7% and RESIDENTIAL decline to 5.7% indicate families are not engaging in outdoor activities. Retail will experience a seasonal boost as indoor shopping becomes the primary family activity over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:Decision date is 2021-07-15, start of school holidays
failure_condition: PARKS improves above -20% within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase by at least 1 percentage point relative to the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has risen consistently to 4.7%, RETAIL_REC has improved to -12.0%, and TRANSIT has improved 5.1 points. These three signals together indicate a coordinated reopening phase where essential and discretionary mobility are both recovering. This multi-domain recovery will reinforce RETAIL_REC gains over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM above 3.0% AND RETAIL_REC above -13% AND TRANSIT above -48%
evidence_refs: fact:All three series show improvement in t-0w
failure_condition: Any of the three proxies reverses by more than 2 percentage points in a single week, or RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the last 28-day mean.
